ml2_adaboost_alpha.source: Exact formula alpha = 0.5 ln((1 - eps) / eps); points are the three rounds of the synthetic AdaBoost example (seed 12).

ml2_adaboost_rounds.source: Discrete AdaBoost with decision stumps on 36 synthetic points (seed 12; true boundary x1 + x2 = 0.15, dotted). Marker area is proportional to the row weight at the start of each round; rings mark rows the current stump misclassifies.

ml2_artifact_bundle.source: Schematic of a versioned model artifact; file names are illustrative.

ml2_bag_vs_boost.source: Schematic comparison of bagging and boosting.

ml2_column_transformer.source: Schematic of a ColumnTransformer inside a Pipeline for the synthetic drilling table; column names are illustrative.

ml2_correlated_importance.source: Synthetic drilling data (seed 11) with a downhole WOB column = 0.92 x surface WOB + noise (sd 4 kN, seed 1; correlation 0.997); RandomForestRegressor (300 trees, min_samples_leaf 3) trained on D1-D4, permutation importance on D5-D6, 30 repeats.

ml2_early_stopping.source: Friedman #1 synthetic regression (10 features, noise sd 3): 400 training rows (seed 1), 2,000 validation rows (seed 2); GradientBoostingRegressor, learning rate 0.1, depth 3. Stop rule: 20 stages without improvement.

ml2_facies_case.source: Synthetic well W8 held out; forest (300 trees, min_samples_leaf 3, seed 0) trained on wells W1-W7; accuracy on W8 = 0.750. Facies: gold sandstone, grey shale, blue limestone; arrows mark misclassified rows.

ml2_forest_diagram.source: Schematic of a random forest classifier; feature names and probabilities are illustrative (the average of 0.82, 0.64 and 0.71 is 0.72).

ml2_forest_regression.source: Synthetic data y = sin(x) + 0.25x + noise (sd 0.35), n = 70 with x drawn uniformly on 0-8, seed 8; RandomForestRegressor, 300 trees, min_samples_leaf = 5, seed 0. Shaded: no training data (x > 8).

ml2_gb_stages.source: Synthetic data y = 2 sin(0.9x) + 0.15x + noise (sd 0.35), n = 60, seed 21; F0 = mean of y = 1.09; depth-2 regression trees; learning rate 0.5.

ml2_hard_soft.source: Exact arithmetic for three illustrative probabilities (0.95, 0.40, 0.45): hard vote share 1/3, soft vote mean 0.60.

ml2_histogram_binning.source: Sixty rows of the synthetic drilling data (seed 4); residuals after the first-stage mean prediction. Candidate splits scored with the squared-error gain G_L²/n_L + G_R²/n_R; best exact threshold 133.5 kN, best histogram threshold 134.3 kN (16 quantile bins; both give the same partition of the 60 rows).

ml2_ice_interaction.source: Centred ICE curves from the synthetic-drilling HistGradientBoostingRegressor (wells D1-D5); 120 of 300 sampled rows shown, coloured by formation (soft: claystone, sandstone; hard: limestone, dolomite). The generator gives rpm less effect in hard rock.

ml2_leakage_selection.source: 20 synthetic datasets (seed 0), each 50 rows x 2000 pure-noise features with random balanced labels; SelectKBest(f_classif, k = 20) + LogisticRegression; 5-fold stratified CV. Means: outside 0.940, inside 0.504.

ml2_loss_gradients.source: Exact functions. Huber threshold delta = 1; p = 1 / (1 + exp(-F)).

ml2_max_features.source: Friedman #1 synthetic regression (12 features, 5 informative, noise sd 1): 16 independent training sets of 300 rows, one 400-row test set; forests of 60 trees. Correlation = between-training-set variance of the forest mean / total variance of one tree (ESL eq. 15.1).

ml2_mdi_bias.source: Synthetic facies logs plus two pure-noise columns (seed 0); RandomForestClassifier, 300 unpruned trees, trained on wells W1-W6; permutation importance on W7-W8, 20 repeats (bars: mean, whiskers: standard deviation).

ml2_missing_route.source: Schematic of native missing-value handling in histogram gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting documentation behaviour).

ml2_monitoring_loop.source: Schematic of a monitoring loop for a deployed model.

ml2_oob_curve.source: Synthetic classification data (600 rows, 10 features, 5 informative, 5% label noise, seed 3); RandomForestClassifier grown with warm_start, seed 0.

ml2_oob_grouped.source: Synthetic facies logs, 8 wells x 160 rows with well offsets and depth-correlated noise (seed 7); RandomForestClassifier, 300 trees, seed 0.

ml2_oob_matrix.source: Bootstrap draws for 10 adjacent depth rows of one synthetic well and 6 trees (seed 2). ×k = row drawn k times; "out" = out of bag for that tree.

ml2_pdp_extrapolation.source: Synthetic drilling data (seed 11) with downhole WOB = 0.92 x surface WOB + noise (sd 4 kN, seed 1). A partial-dependence curve for surface WOB pairs each of 8 grid values with 120 sampled observed downhole values. x = farther (standardized) from every observed row than 99% of rows are from their nearest neighbour.

ml2_pdp_ice.source: HistGradientBoostingRegressor (FORMATION categorical, seed 0) trained on synthetic wells D1-D5; sklearn.inspection.partial_dependence over 300 sampled training rows, 40 grid points between the 5th and 95th percentiles.

ml2_rop_boosting.source: Synthetic drilling wells (seed 11): trained on D1-D5, evaluated on held-out well D6. RandomForestRegressor (300 trees, min_samples_leaf 3) and HistGradientBoostingRegressor (defaults), seed 0. MAE: Training mean 7.10, Deep tree 2.80, Random forest 2.50, Hist. gradient boosting 2.67 m/h.

ml2_rop_motivation.source: Synthetic drilling wells (seed 11); five bootstrap resamples of wells D1-D5 (seed 3); each model predicts held-out well D6. Spread = standard deviation across the five models, averaged over depth (trees 2.64, forests 0.95 m/h).

ml2_shap_waterfall.source: Exact interventional Shapley values for one row of synthetic well D6 (see ml2_shapley_lattice); base 23.38 + contributions +4.43, +2.72, -15.01 = 15.52 m/h.

ml2_shapley_lattice.source: Exact interventional Shapley computation for one row of held-out well D6 (WOB 168 kN, 178 rpm, dolomite): GradientBoostingRegressor on WOB, RPM and FORMATION (wells D1-D5, seed 0); v(S) = mean prediction over 200 background rows with the features in S set to this row. Values in m/h.

ml2_stacking_diagram.source: Schematic of stacking with K = 5 folds and three base models.

ml2_subsample.source: Friedman #1 synthetic regression (noise sd 2), five independent datasets of 600 training and 2,000 validation rows (seeds 0-4); GradientBoostingRegressor, learning rate 0.1, depth 3.

ml2_tree_growth.source: Schematic: three trees with three split nodes each, grown by different policies; numbers give the order in which splits are made.

ml2_tree_instability.source: Synthetic two-moons data (n = 220, noise 0.23, seed 42); bootstrap seed 18; unpruned scikit-learn trees. Hollow markers are rows left out of that bootstrap sample.

ml2_vote_curves.source: Exact binomial majority probabilities. Right: with probability rho all voters copy one shared vote (pairwise correlation of correctness = rho), otherwise they vote independently; accuracy = rho*p + (1-rho)*P(majority).

ml2_vote_pmf.source: Exact binomial probabilities, n = 5 independent voters, each correct with p = 0.7.
